questions.stem: In what order does the body typically use respiratory substrates during prolonged exercise?

options.text: Proteins first, then lipids, then carbohydrates
Lipids first, then proteins, then carbohydrates
Carbohydrates first, then lipids, then proteins
All three are used equally at all times

questions.explanation: The body preferentially uses carbohydrates (glycogen and glucose) first as they are quickest to break down. Once these run low, lipids are used. Proteins are only used as a last resort during starvation.
